name: ThirdShotHub Cold Court 40 Outdoor Pickleballs
description: ThirdShotHub Cold Court 40 balls are built for winter and early-morning outdoor play. Standard outdoor balls turn brittle and crack quickly when temperatures drop below 50°F; the Cold Court 40 uses a softer TPE polymer blend that stays flexible down to 35°F, keeping bounce consistent and resisting cracks in cold weather. The 40-hole pattern is tuned for wind resistance on open courts.
care_instructions: Store balls indoors at room temperature between sessions and bring them to the court in a bag to slow cooling. Replace a ball once it goes out of round or starts to crack.
